set.body: Build the Odersky-style algebra over typed spaces: MvMap, IdentityMap, MatrixMap, ComposedMap, RestrictedMap, Decoder, Projector, BiProjection, and law tests. Projection must mean preprocess(X) * weights; score recovery and least-squares decoding are explicit operations requiring solver capability. Acceptance: identity and composition laws hold; restriction commutes with transform; decoder semantics are explicit; mvproj law fixtures are ported to shared tests and pass on JVM and JS.
set.title: Multivar algebra: maps, projectors, decoders, and laws
